title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile — Episode5 Train! Train! Train!

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: In order to gain control over your smallest muscles, you have to first start paying close attention to what they're doing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Pay close attention... Hnng!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Meditation can help with that.
Close your eyes and focus all your attention on your nervous system.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You'll be able to feel what your entire body is doing from your head to your toes...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
The air as it caresses your skin...
Feel what your muscles underneath are doing, and learn how to control them!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Your mind plays an important role, but your muscles are the ones doing all the work. They come first, second, third, fourth... Hundredth and foremost!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Now, come with me!
We're going to do ten laps of this park while dragging these tires around!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Your mind and muscles need to work together in order to achieve perfect control. Next, we'll do an exercise which covers both!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Stretch your arms out and gently squat like you're sitting down... Okay, stop there! Now stay in that position for ten minutes!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: This exercise isn't just designed to help strengthen your muscles. You have to finely control them in order to maintain the same posture. So, try to hang in there!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: N-Nooo... M-My legs are starting to wobble...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can do it, Emu! Hang in there!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Think about the role you're playing!
Are you going to break character because of a little pain?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
You can do this!
The muscles in your bodies are made for this!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Tsukasa, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: Right!
bgm_area00004
A few days later
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: L-Like this...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's perfect!
Now try to stay still while keeping your arms stretched out and bottom down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
O-Oww!
My legs are getting wobbly...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Just a little longer...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys got this! Just thirty more seconds...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: ...twenty-nine, thirty! Okay, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was rough!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I can't feel my legs...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you guys have been doing stuff like this every day, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! The exercise you just did is meant to help strengthen your thighs and core!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's to make sure you can keep your posture while performing no matter what your body is doing...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's incredible.
Can you tell us about any other exercises you've been doing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, to list a few...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've been meditating, pulling tires around and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, this might sound a little weird, but we also did cat's cradle and even an exercise that involved learning to move our ears...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I haven't managed to yet, but anyone apparently can given enough practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Strength training and conditioning are both important, but the primary goal of these exercises is to achieve perfect control of our bodies.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've mostly been learning how to control every muscle right down to our fingertips, including ones we don't think about normally.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! That sounds challenging, but also fun...! Can you tell us more about what you guys have been doing later?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's nice to hear that you're already learning so much from this other troupe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And they sound very different from Shunmeiza, so I'm sure you all stand to gain quite a lot from working with them!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Especially you, Emu.
You seem really pumped up today for some reason!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is it because you were chosen to play the lead?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
Also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I absolutely want this play to succeed so that we get to be a part of Mikazukigumi's next production!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Since working with lots and lots of people on lots and lots of different things seems like the best way for us to learn!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even when we were working with Shunmeiza, working with proven talent helped us make quite a few new discoveries.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, from Seiryuin to Asahi and Bakuno...
Getting to perform alongside such talented people has already helped us learn a lot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, and...
Performing on a real stage is simply the best way to gain experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, in order to make our dreams come true, let's make our play about Ushiwakamaru a good one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's all do some of those exercises again together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Starting from the top of the Kijima Special! Sprinting at full speed! Let's go!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Emu, wait! I wanna run with you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We should join her as well!
Not so fast, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, everyone's so full of energy today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I love how motivated they are!
Let's all run with them, shall we?!
